release_notes: Build 137 removes the obsolete five-minute Autopilot recovery supervisor source now that it is no longer part of startup.

The retired Build 52-54 installed-database recovery v1 implementation and its dedicated tests have been removed; current Library V2/V3 recovery, project consolidation and database backup/restore protections remain in place.
The aligned Needs You task queue now awaits the current asynchronous count refresh directly, removing the temporary compatibility shim.
This is a maintenance cleanup release with no intended change to normal quiz creation, publishing or recovery behavior.
